Our Story

About PG MUN

Fostering the Next Generation of Global Leaders

PG MUN 2026 is Phoenix Greens School of Learning's flagship Model United Nations conference — a two-day immersive simulation where students step into the shoes of world diplomats, debate pressing global issues, and draft resolutions that mirror the work of actual UN bodies.

Founded on the belief that informed dialogue drives real change, PG MUN brings together some of the brightest young minds to engage in structured debate, negotiation, and collaborative problem-solving across six carefully curated committees.

Whether you're a seasoned delegate or attending your very first MUN, PG MUN 2026 is designed to challenge, inspire, and equip you with skills that extend far beyond the conference room — critical thinking, public speaking, research, and the art of diplomacy.

Theme: Diplomacy · Dialogue · Change

Our theme this year reflects a fundamental truth: global challenges are never solved in isolation. It takes diplomacy to bridge differences, dialogue to find common ground, and collective will to drive meaningful change. Every session, every resolution, every negotiation at PG MUN embodies this spirit.

Event Programme

Schedule

Day One
July 17, 2026
08:00 — 09:00
Registration & Delegate Welcome
Credential check, delegate kits, and networking breakfast.
09:00 — 09:45
Opening Ceremony
Address by the Secretary-General, keynote speaker, and flag parade.
10:00 — 13:00
Committee Session I
Roll call, opening speeches, and general speakers' list.
13:00 — 14:00
Lunch Break
Refreshments provided on campus.
14:00 — 17:30
Committee Session II
Moderated caucus, unmoderated caucus, and resolution drafting begins.
18:00 — 20:00
Delegate Social Evening
Networking dinner and cultural programme. Smart-casual dress.
Day Two
July 18, 2026
08:30 — 09:00
Morning Assembly
Committee briefing and resolution review session.
09:00 — 12:30
Committee Session III
Final resolution drafting, amendments, and voting procedure.
12:30 — 13:30
Lunch Break
Refreshments provided on campus.
13:30 — 15:30
Committee Session IV
Crisis simulations, final voting, and passing of resolutions.
16:00 — 17:30
Closing Ceremony
Award presentations, Best Delegate, High Commendation, Outstanding, and Verbal Mention.
17:30
Conference Concludes
Photographs, farewells, and certificate distribution.

Info
June 2026

Registrations Are Now Open

We are excited to announce that registrations for PG MUN 2026 are officially open! Delegates can now submit their preferences for committees and countries. Seats are limited — register early to secure your allocation.

Important
July 2026

Conference Dates Confirmed

PG MUN 2026 will be held on July 17–18, 2026 at Phoenix Greens School of Learning, Hyderabad. All delegates are requested to arrive by 8:30 AM on July 17 for registration and briefing.
